facts.fact: Neela's drawn-out tell when asked about the eleventh-step turn: she says 'I don't know', her lips move on a count and her thumbnail drags along her forefinger nail.
Neela counts the doors in every room she sleeps in, and says so to Devan; she answered to 'Seventeen' for twenty-one years.
Devan keeps a private tally of Neela's bare nights and chooses not to ask what ends at the new moon.
